title: V Global Crypto Exchange Accomplices Handed Suspended Sentences in $1.4B Fraud Case
summary: Executives who helped the bogus crypto exchange V Global dupe some 50,000 customers out of some $1.4 billion have escaped jail. The post V Global Crypto Exchange Accomplices Handed Suspended Sentences in $1.4B Fraud Case appeared first on Cryptonews .

title: UK Food Group Seeks Easier Regulatory Burden as Inflation Bites
summary: Food inflation in the UK is expected to accelerate to the fastest pace since the start of last year as manufacturers struggle with the “financial burden of government policies,” according to a group that represents the industry.
